# Synthetic PNG fixtures

Small project-owned inputs generated by `generate.py` with Python standard-library
zlib and explicit PNG chunks/CRCs, independently of the product's LodePNG codec.
The two valid files encode the same 2×2 top-down RGB8 pixels:
`(10,32,255), (0,128,13); (1,2,3), (250,100,50)`.
The RGBA files have alpha 255 everywhere. Adam7 variants exercise interlacing;
a text-tagged variant exercises ignored metadata. Negative inputs cover direct
alpha and RGB transparency keys, corrupt ancillary CRC,
grayscale, 16-bit samples, APNG, excessive inflated data, and oversized dimensions.
No capture data or proprietary files are included. The generator is not a build
or test prerequisite; the C++ check consumes these checked-in files.
